invariants.expression: b == 0 ? result == Integer.MIN_VALUE : result == a / b
invariants.rationale: Reflects the method's core logic: returns Integer.MIN_VALUE when divisor is zero, otherwise returns the quotient.
If b is zero, the result is guaranteed to be Integer.MIN_VALUE.
If divisor is not zero, result must equal the division of a by b using integer division.
Ensures that when b is zero, result cannot be anything but Integer.MIN_VALUE.
Ensures logical consistency: in all cases where b == 0, the result is Integer.MIN_VALUE.
